Dear Zane Thistlewood,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring your Tindall Skylark for a commercial shoot. We would like to arrange for the vehicle to be picked up on 6th July 2027 at 12:30 and brought back on July 8, 2027 at 12:30. We will be dropping off the vehicle at the Saltmarsh Lighthouse Hotel and would appreciate it if you could collect it from there afterwards. I have included a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Your Tindall Skylark
Zane Thistlewood
+70 505 159 4699
